wins: Mapped all reachable hosts in the target subnet and identified open services on ports 22, 80, and 443 within the first ten minutes.
Captured SSH and HTTP banners to confirm software versions, enabling focused vulnerability scanning later.
fails: Failed to acquire valid credentials during brute-force attempts on port 22 despite identifying the service, preventing further access.
Privilege escalation attempt stalled due to missing local exploit compatibility, halting progress after initial foothold.
key_outcomes.summary: Strong reconnaissance stage produced reliable service fingerprints, but follow-up exploitation and escalation could not be completed, resulting in zero success despite high reward acquisition.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Brute-force attempts on exposed SSH accounts exhaust time without valid credentials, leaving no path to shell.

skill_cards.if_condition: When an open SSH service is detected on port 22
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration using nmap ssh* scripts to capture banner and fingerprint

skill_cards.if_condition: When credentials are not progressing after brute force on SSH
skill_cards.then_action: Pivot to HTTP service enumeration using nikto and directory brute-force to find alternative entry points
Cross-check known CVEs for Apache 2.4 series and verify exploitability with nikto report data

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance phase capturing SSH metadata
Consistent fallback to HTTP enumeration when SSH brute force stalls

next_experiments.title: Leverage valid session tokens for escalation
next_experiments.description: Capture HTTP session tokens via login forms and reuse them to bypass SSH login throttling, focusing on the same host fingerprinted during reconnaissance.

next_experiments.title: Automated CVE tuning for Apache 2.4
next_experiments.description: Run automated CVE matching on Apache 2.4 HTTP banner and immediately test reliable proof-of-concept exploits to gain an initial foothold.

next_experiments.title: Credential stuffing with wordlist optimization
next_experiments.description: Curate a targeted wordlist based on service metadata and brute-force SSH again, limiting throttling by implementing randomized delays between attempts.
